name: Kobalt

name: CREngine
description: Book layout and rendering. Based on Cool Reader by Vadim Lopatin and contributions from the KOReader community. Includes vertical writing from m-tky/crengine at 6a56ffa0f1afc95e9e5463c5ca6584f57022d047 and local rendering changes.

name: KOReader-base

name: HarfBuzz

name: LunaSVG and PlutoVG
description: SVG rendering, by Nwutobo Samuel Ugochukwu and contributors. PlutoVG includes FreeType rasterization code by David Turner, Robert Wilhelm and Werner Lemberg.

name: libjpeg-turbo
description: JPEG decoding. This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

name: libpng
version: Android 1.6.59; device or SDK library on other targets
description: PNG decoding, by the PNG Reference Library authors.

name: zlib
description: Compression support, by Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler.

name: FriBidi
description: Unicode bidirectional text support, by the FriBidi contributors.

name: libunibreak
description: Unicode line and word breaking, by Wu Yongwei and contributors.

name: utf8proc
description: Unicode normalization for book search. By the utf8proc contributors. Includes Unicode data.

name: xxHash

name: OpenSSL

name: NickelHook

name: Qt

name: IBM Plex Sans and Mono

name: Instrument Serif
